name: asset_instrument
definition:
SELECT a.id AS asset_id,
    a.asset_code,
    a.asset_type,
    a.name AS asset_name,
    a.brand_model,
    a.serial_no,
    a.plate_no,
    a.status AS asset_status,
    a.custodian_id AS custodian_employee_id,
    e.full_name AS custodian_name,
    e.employment_status AS custodian_status,
    a.purchase_date,
    a.purchase_cost AS purchase_cost_twd
   FROM asset a
     LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.custodian_id;

name: case_project
definition:
SELECT ca.id AS case_id,
    ca.case_code,
    ca.main_code,
    ca.suffix_code AS sub_code,
    ca.suffix_depth,
    ca.parent_case_id,
    p.case_code AS parent_case_code,
    ca.title AS case_title,
    ca.category AS case_category,
    ca.region,
    ca.customer_id,
    cu.name AS customer_name,
    ca.pm_employee_id,
    pm.full_name AS pm_name,
    ca.sales_employee_id,
    sa.full_name AS sales_name,
    ca.status AS lifecycle_stage,
    ca.quoted_total AS quoted_total_twd,
    ca.contract_total AS contract_amount_twd,
    ca.billed_total AS billed_total_twd,
    ca.received_total AS received_total_twd,
    ca.start_date,
    ca.due_date,
    ca.closed_date,
    ca.source_v3_id AS source_v3_record_id,
    ca.source_v4_id AS source_v4_record_id,
    ca.source_quote_id AS source_quote_record_id
   FROM "case" ca
     LEFT JOIN "case" p ON p.id = ca.parent_case_id
     LEFT JOIN customer cu ON cu.id = ca.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN employee pm ON pm.id = ca.pm_employee_id
     LEFT JOIN employee sa ON sa.id = ca.sales_employee_id;

name: customer
definition:
SELECT id AS customer_id,
    customer_code,
    name AS customer_name,
    norm_name AS normalized_name,
    tax_id,
    category AS customer_type,
    phone,
    address,
    status AS customer_status,
    created_at
   FROM customer c;

name: district_mileage
definition:
SELECT id AS district_mileage_id,
    city_name,
    district_name,
    distance_km AS round_trip_km,
    allowance_tier AS allowance_amount_twd,
    source_base_token,
    source_record_id
   FROM district_distance dd;

name: employee
definition:
SELECT id AS employee_id,
    employee_no AS employee_code,
    full_name,
    norm_name AS normalized_name,
    department_id,
    department_name,
    team_code,
    job_title,
    employment_status,
    hire_date,
    resign_date AS termination_date,
    is_field_staff,
    is_inner_staff,
    lark_open_id,
    lark_union_id,
    union_id_source,
    identity_confirmed,
    identity_confirmed_by,
    identity_confirmed_by_employee_id,
    identity_confirmed_at
   FROM employee e;

name: attendance_daily
definition:
SELECT ad.id AS attendance_day_id,
    ad.employee_id,
    e.employee_no AS employee_code,
    e.full_name AS employee_name,
    ad.work_date AS attendance_date,
    (e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(ad.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text) AS person_day_key,
    (e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(ad.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text) AS emp_date_key,
    (e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(ad.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMM'::text) AS emp_month_key,
    ad.source_system,
        CASE
            WHEN ad.work_date < d0() THEN 'V3'::text
            ELSE 'V4'::text
        END AS payroll_feed_source,
    ad.day_type,
    ad.clock_in_at AS first_punch_in,
    ad.clock_out_at AS last_punch_out,
    ad.regular_hours,
    ad.anomaly_status,
    ad.employee_confirmed,
    ad.source_record_id AS lark_att_record_id
   FROM attendance_day ad
     JOIN employee e ON e.id = ad.employee_id;

name: attendance_hours_monthly
definition:
WITH ot_by_emp_month AS (
         SELECT ot.employee_id,
            to_char(ot.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS period_ym,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = 'weekday'::text THEN LEAST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric), 2.0) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS weekday_tier1_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = 'weekday'::text THEN GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric) - 2.0, 2.0), 0::numeric) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS weekday_tier2_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = 'weekday'::text THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric) - 4.0, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS weekday_tier3_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = 'restday'::text THEN LEAST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric), 2.0) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS restday_tier1_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = 'restday'::text THEN GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric) - 2.0, 6.0), 0::numeric) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS restday_tier2_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = 'restday'::text THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric) - 8.0, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS restday_tier3_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = ANY (ARRAY['holiday'::text, 'national_holiday'::text]) THEN LEAST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric), 8.0) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS holiday_tier1_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = ANY (ARRAY['holiday'::text, 'national_holiday'::text]) THEN GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric) - 8.0, 2.0), 0::numeric) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS holiday_tier2_min,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ot.day_type = ANY (ARRAY['holiday'::text, 'national_holiday'::text]) THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(ot.approved_ot_hours, 0::numeric) - 10.0, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END))::integer AS holiday_tier3_min
           FROM overtime_day ot
          WHERE ot.status = 'approved'::text
          GROUP BY ot.employee_id, (to_char(ot.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text))
        )
 SELECT pl.employee_id,
    e.employee_no AS employee_code,
    e.full_name AS employee_name,
    pr.period_ym,
    pl.work_days,
    pl.leave_hours,
    COALESCE(otm.weekday_tier1_min, round(COALESCE(pl.ot_tier1_hours, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric)::integer) AS weekday_tier1_min,
    COALESCE(otm.weekday_tier2_min, round(COALESCE(pl.ot_tier2_hours, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric)::integer) AS weekday_tier2_min,
    COALESCE(otm.weekday_tier3_min, 0) AS weekday_tier3_min,
    COALESCE(otm.restday_tier1_min, 0) AS restday_tier1_min,
    COALESCE(otm.restday_tier2_min, 0) AS restday_tier2_min,
    COALESCE(otm.restday_tier3_min, 0) AS restday_tier3_min,
    COALESCE(otm.holiday_tier1_min, round(COALESCE(pl.ot_tier3_hours, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric)::integer) AS holiday_tier1_min,
    COALESCE(otm.holiday_tier2_min, 0) AS holiday_tier2_min,
    COALESCE(otm.holiday_tier3_min, 0) AS holiday_tier3_min,
    jsonb_build_object('weekday', jsonb_build_object('tier1_min', COALESCE(otm.weekday_tier1_min, round(COALESCE(pl.ot_tier1_hours, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric)::integer), 'tier2_min', COALESCE(otm.weekday_tier2_min, round(COALESCE(pl.ot_tier2_hours, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric)::integer), 'tier3_min', COALESCE(otm.weekday_tier3_min, 0)), 'restday', jsonb_build_object('tier1_min', COALESCE(otm.restday_tier1_min, 0), 'tier2_min', COALESCE(otm.restday_tier2_min, 0), 'tier3_min', COALESCE(otm.restday_tier3_min, 0)), 'holiday', jsonb_build_object('tier1_min', COALESCE(otm.holiday_tier1_min, round(COALESCE(pl.ot_tier3_hours, 0::numeric) * 60::numeric)::integer), 'tier2_min', COALESCE(otm.holiday_tier2_min, 0), 'tier3_min', COALESCE(otm.holiday_tier3_min, 0))) AS ot_minutes_by_type_tier
   FROM payroll_line pl
     JOIN payroll_run pr ON pr.id = pl.run_id
     JOIN employee e ON e.id = pl.employee_id
     LEFT JOIN ot_by_emp_month otm ON otm.employee_id = pl.employee_id AND otm.period_ym = pr.period_ym;

name: quote_pipeline
definition:
SELECT q.id AS quote_id,
    q.quote_no,
    q.customer_id,
    cu.name AS customer_name,
    q.case_id AS linked_case_id,
    ca.case_code AS linked_case_code,
    q.project_title AS quote_title,
    q.status AS quote_status,
    q.quote_date AS quoted_date,
    q.quoted_total AS quoted_total_twd,
    q.raw_case_code AS legacy_prelim_code,
    q.source_base_token,
    q.source_record_id AS lark_quote_record_id,
    q.raw_unique_quote_no,
    q.auto_quote_no,
    q.auto_seq_no,
    q.canonical_quote_no
   FROM quote q
     LEFT JOIN customer cu ON cu.id = q.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN "case" ca ON ca.id = q.case_id;

name: work_order_crew_share
definition:
SELECT woc.id AS crew_share_id,
    wo.work_order_id,
    wo.work_order_no,
    wo.work_type,
    wo.work_date,
    wo.source_system,
    wo.sot_system_by_d0,
    woc.employee_id,
    e.employee_no AS employee_code,
    e.full_name AS employee_name,
    (((e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(wo.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text)) || '_'::text) || wo.work_order_id::text AS crew_share_natural_key,
    (e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(wo.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text) AS person_day_key,
    (e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(wo.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text) AS emp_date_key,
    (e.employee_no || '_'::text) || to_char(wo.work_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMM'::text) AS emp_month_key,
    wo.case_id,
    wo.case_code,
    woc.role_in_crew,
    woc.hours_worked,
    woc.share_ratio,
    woc.allocated_points,
    woc.employee_confirmed
   FROM work_order_crew woc
     JOIN fact.work_order_daily wo ON wo.work_order_id = woc.work_order_id
     JOIN employee e ON e.id = woc.employee_id;

name: work_order_daily
definition:
SELECT wo.id AS work_order_id,
    wo.wo_no AS work_order_no,
    wo.kind AS work_type,
    wo.work_date,
    wo.source_system,
        CASE
            WHEN wo.work_date < d0() THEN 'V3'::text
            ELSE 'V4'::text
        END AS sot_system_by_d0,
    wo.case_id,
    ca.case_code,
    ca.title AS case_title,
    wo.pending_bucket_id,
    wo.contract_item_id,
    wo.team_code,
    wo.lead_employee_id AS leader_employee_id,
    le.full_name AS leader_name,
    wo.work_item_name,
    wo.status AS review_status,
    wo.output_points,
    wo.output_value_twd,
    wo.weather,
    wo.location_text,
    wo.source_record_id AS lark_wo_record_id
   FROM work_order wo
     LEFT JOIN "case" ca ON ca.id = wo.case_id
     LEFT JOIN employee le ON le.id = wo.lead_employee_id;
